messages:
sam_oncall: Investigating increased launch failures for Dedicated nodes in eu-north1. Seeing NAT gateway errors + KMS timeouts. Customers seeing 502/504s and some provisioning jobs stuck.
infra-bot: Alert: eu-north1 NATGatewayCarrierFlap - 200+ errors in last 5m. Affected services: provisioning, kms-connector.
mia_infra: Confirmed — LB healthchecks to gpu-provisioner are flaky, and KMS encrypt calls return 5xx intermittently. Provisioning tokens can't be unwrapped.
alex_really: Logs show repeated: `ERROR kms-client: encrypt request failed status=502` then `provisioner: instance start timeout (30m)`. GPU pools show pending pods.
rahul_platform: Rolling to fallback plan. Plan A: shift new provisioning traffic to eu-west1 reserved pool (we have spare capacity). Plan B: if KMS persists, enable local key-wrap cache on provisioner to use cached key-encryption-key for 30m.
lee_ops: How fast can we route provisioning requests out of region? We need to update smart-routing policy and announce to routers.
carol_se: I can patch the smart router policy: add rule `region==eu-north1 && service==provisioning -> prefer eu-west1, fallback eu-central1`. Should be a config push + 2s deploy.
sam_oncall: Do it. Also add a temporary path that pins active workloads to existing healthy nodes so we don't try to spawn new ones.
alex_really: Pushed routing config (canary) to 5% traffic, looks stable. Increasing to 50% now.
infra-bot: Deploy: route-policy/provisioning updated by carol_se. Canary 5% -> 50% -> 100% in progress.
mia_infra: KMS vendor says they're seeing packet loss between our NAT IP block and their endpoints (carrier-level). They're escalating to networking. Cloud provider has an ongoing carrier flap in the POP.
rahul_platform: OK, continue routing. Meanwhile, enable local KMS cache on provisioner: set `ENABLE_KMS_CACHE=true; KMS_CACHE_TTL=1800` on the provisioner deployment. That will avoid new encrypt calls for short-lived launches.
lee_ops: Patching now. Command used: `kubectl -n infra set env deploy/provisioner ENABLE_KMS_CACHE=true KMS_CACHE_TTL=1800`.
alex_really: Done. Observed provisioning success rate moved from ~60% -> ~92% after routing + cache. Some older jobs still stuck — we should retry them.
carol_se: I'll kick a retry job for pending provision tasks: `scripts/provision_retry --region eu-north1 --only-stuck`. Running now.
sam_oncall: Good. Track ETA for cloud provider mitigation. Also open incident with sales/support to notify affected customers.
mia_infra: Noted a subtlety: KV cache in runtime interacts with token unwrapping; we must ensure cached keys are only used for provisioning; runtime inference keys must still go to KMS to preserve access controls. Adding guardrails.
rahul_platform: Also flag: local cache increases risk window if a key is rotated. We set TTL short (30m) and will force eviction on rotation. Documenting in incident notes.
lee_ops: Cost note: routing to eu-west1 will bump egress and cross-region allocation; estimate +12% provisioning spend if sustained. Flagging finance.
carol_se: Finance pinged. We should also check if Dedicated reserved capacity can be rebalanced long-term to reduce cross-region bursts.
infra-bot: Incident update: routing shift completed, KMS cache enabled, provisioning success restored to 95%. Ongoing: cloud provider carrier investigation.
sam_oncall: Next steps: 1) keep routing until provider confirms fix, 2) run retry for stuck jobs, 3) postmortem to cover why provisioning relied on remote KMS path, 4) add runbook step to enable local key-wrap cache during external KMS outages.
alex_really: I'll create a short runbook PR after this stabilizes. Also opened ticket EDGE-4521 for provider follow-up.
carol_se: Notifying customers now with templated note, linking to status page.
rahul_platform: If provider reports complete fix, we'll roll routing back slowly and drain eu-west1 excess.
sam_oncall: Thanks all. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
